title: CATVariant: a web server for integrated protein variant interpretation across sequence; structure; population; and clinical evidence.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo record 19121409 (MIT licence) holds one file, source_code.zip (2.97 MB, 233 files). I listed its contents: the backend code, a pickled classifier (variant_ml_predictor.pkl) and training_report.json. There are no CSV/TSV/XLSX data tables, so the 6,388-variant review set is not deposited there. The Europe PMC supplementary-file request timed out after 75 s, so the supplement was not retrievable.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The 6,388 ClinVar-derived review-set variants across 22 proteins, and the 76% pathogenic-over-benign pairwise ranking, come from the abstract only. The web server's contents were not probed.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked the files: the only deposit is code. The review-set variant table is not released, and the web server returns results for one query at a time rather than offering a bulk data download.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No labelled table exists in the deposit. Pathogenic/benign labels would have to be rebuilt from ClinVar (the public clinical variant database) by re-applying the paper's filters, so the label would be constructed.

a3_inputs_present.note: No variant table was deposited, so there are no inputs to check.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable: the label is a binary class (pathogenic or benign).

a5_enough_rows.note: The paper claims 6,388 variants, but I did not see any file containing them.

a6_fits_laptop.note: It would be small if the table existed.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Can't be checked because no data file was deposited.

a8_label_provenance.note: ClinVar labels are expert or clinical-lab classifications, not model outputs. However, they are known to be biased by gene, and computational predictor scores are sometimes used as evidence for them.

existing_models.name: AlphaMissense (Science 2023, a model that predicts whether a missense variant causes disease)
existing_models.score_and_split: auROC (area under the ROC curve, 1.0 = perfect) of 0.940 on 18,924 ClinVar test variants. Precomputed scores are public; full weights are restricted.
existing_models.authors_named_unsolved: Not retrieved. A 2026 bioRxiv preprint reports that gene identity, not variant effect, dominates ClinVar benchmarks.

backbone.name: ESM-2, a protein language model (would be the natural choice)

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Not applicable: this paper deposits no data, so there is nothing of its own to join.

honest_claim_h3: No claim is possible from this paper's data: it is a web tool, and its benchmark variant set is not deposited.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use combined sequence, structure, population and clinical evidence to predict whether a protein variant causes disease.
plain_idea.train_on: Single amino-acid changes in 22 proteins, each described by evidence features. The count is unknown because the table was not deposited; the paper claims 6,388.
plain_idea.predict: Pathogenic versus benign, taken from high-confidence ClinVar classifications made by clinical labs and expert panels.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Clinical geneticists need to rank variants of uncertain significance. But this task is crowded, and the paper adds no new labelled data.

label_elsewhere.sources: ClinVar (known resource), which is the source of this paper's labels.
label_elsewhere.join_key: UniProt accession + position / HGVS variant notation
label_elsewhere.why: The label exists only as a re-filtering of ClinVar, so the paper adds nothing beyond going to ClinVar directly.

ml_idea: Pathogenicity classification on ClinVar missense variants with evidence features. This paper adds no new data, and the task is saturated (AlphaMissense and many others).

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: there is no data table to size.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Done: listed the Zenodo deposit and found code only, with no variant table.

verdict_reason: This is a web-server paper. Zenodo holds only source code, with no variant table; the 6,388-variant ClinVar review set is not deposited, so the labels would have to be rebuilt from ClinVar (A1/A2 fail). Pathogenicity prediction on ClinVar is also already crowded.
